_about: Design-free site footer shared by every concept (build.py resolves it into the `footer` object passed to templates). Everything here is traced to the crawl; nothing written new except short functional labels. columns come from nav.json (one per folder, items with no live page left out, the same rule as the header). contact.from=closing takes address, phone, fax and email from the live shared contact block. page = a built mockup page slug (resolved to a relative href); url = an external link.
